purpose: Describe what could happen in principle.
keywords: Even a small error can change the result.
It is an accident that could happen to anyone.
I listed the methods conceivable at present.
restrictions: Dictionary form permits える or うる; inflections use え, as in 得ない.
mistake: Use the ordinary potential form for someone’s learned ability.
